WITH cpi_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry,
        a.artdynasty,
        ((ar.histsignrating + ar.researchvalrating + ar.cultscore) * 
         (10 - CASE ac.conservestatus 
               WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 
               WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 
               WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 
               WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 
               WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 
               ELSE 0 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
    FROM artifactscore a
    JOIN artifactratings ar ON a.artregistry = ar.artref
    JOIN conservationandmaintenance ac ON a.artregistry = ac.artrefmaintained
),
dynasty_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        artdynasty AS dynasty_name,
        SUM(cpi) AS total_cpi,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1 END) AS adequate_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS insufficient_count,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(cpi * (CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)) / COUNT(*) AS numeric), 2) AS budget_efficiency,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' AND ac.conservestatus = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_critical_insufficient
    FROM cpi_calc c
    JOIN artifactscore a ON c.artregistry = a.artregistry
    JOIN conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
    JOIN conservationandmaintenance ac ON a.artregistry = ac.artrefmaintained
    GROUP BY artdynasty
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        dynasty_name,
        total_cpi,
        adequate_count,
        insufficient_count,
        budget_efficiency,
        has_critical_insufficient,
        CASE 
            WHEN budget_efficiency < 0.5 AND has_critical_insufficient = 1 THEN 'Budget Crisis'
            ELSE 'Within Budget'
        END AS budget_status
    FROM dynasty_stats
)
